# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Cross reference the building and fire service documentation, where available.
3. List all issues described as no/equivocal/unsatisfactory by the inspection services.
4. Categorize the defect type by comparing to the requirements in the relevant Building Fire Safety Standards.
   * If the issue does not match with reported requirements, add it to the generic list.
5. Use the standard terminology when identifying the issue. Use the terms consistent with the relevant standard used for inspection.
6. Inspections are performed periodically, with the most recent assessments noted. Changes or outliers in inspection results can be identified with data from ASM / FIREMAN.
7. Note on the records any repairs or completed work. Include the date of completion.
8. Update the AutoCAD drawings by putting an "X" across the defective equipment and recording the location by elevations/floors. # Inspection particulars
